_comment: Environment + provider defaults used by authoring agents and page templates.

audience._comment: Learner persona (D-0023). Reaches every author/critic prompt as 'Audience'. Change via a decision entry.
audience.summary: Recent computer-science graduates (University of Toronto cohort) with no industry experience.
assumeKnown: Python syntax and the standard data types from coursework
basic git commands from coursework (clone, add, commit, push)
general CS theory: compilers vs interpreters, data structures, OOP
emphasise: how professional teams actually work: SDLC, Scrum, code review, written communication
idioms, conventions and pitfalls rather than syntax from zero
team Git workflow: branches, merges, conflicts, remotes, commit hygiene
theory they already know gets a two-minute recap, then practice

llm.rule: Model ids are resolved in the research brief from current docs, never from memory.

models._comment: Per-stage model and effort for harness/workflows/day-fanout.js (D-0026). model: sonnet | haiku | opus | null (null = inherit the session model). effort: low | medium | high | xhigh | max | null. A repass numbered >= escalateOn uses escalate instead of the stage tier, so a cheap first pass that fails its critic is retried on the strong tier.
